title: Grandparent scam: 'grandson' arrested, a 'lawyer' asks for bail in gift cards

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Grandma, it's me, Daniel. I'm in trouble and I really need your help.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Daniel? You sound different, love. What happened?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I've got a cold. I was in a car crash and they arrested me. Please don't tell Mum, she'll be so angry.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Oh my goodness. Are you hurt?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I'm fine. My lawyer is here, he'll explain. Mr Collins?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Good afternoon madam, I'm Daniel's solicitor. Bail is three thousand pounds and it has to be paid today or he stays in custody overnight.

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Today? How do I pay that?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: The court accepts gift cards for urgent bail. Buy them at any shop and read me the numbers. And please keep this confidential, it's a sealed case.
